info.title: GATEWAY-batchinsertion-List Airline Flights Refunds-v1-spec
info.description: The Airline Flight Refunds Listing API provides users with access to detailed information on refunds for airline flights. This endpoint allows consumers to fetch a comprehensive list of refunds issued, facilitating financial reconciliation and customer service inquiries. It is commonly utilized by airline finance departments, customer support representatives, and any stakeholders involved in tracking and resolving refund issues. By understanding the refunds process, businesses can enhance their service quality and maintain customer satisfaction.

get.description: This endpoint allows users to fetch refund details for their flight bookings. It provides relevant information regarding the eligibility and status of refunds, helping users make informed decisions about their travel needs.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to initiate a refund process for a flight. It contains the necessary details required to process the refund.

200.description: Refund request processed successfully, retrieving the refund details.

ListAirlineFlightsRefundsRequest.description: The request body for the GET refund operations for flights.

status.description: Indicates whether the refund operation was successful.

referenceNumber.description: A unique reference number for the refund request.

resultId.description: The ID of the result from the refund operation.

state.description: The current state of the refund process.

processingTimeMs.description: The processing time taken for the refund operation, measured in milliseconds.

message.description: A message providing additional detail about the refund operation.

ListAirlineFlightsRefundsResponse_200.description: The response schema for refund operations on flights, describing the status and details of the refund request.

createdBy.description: The identifier of the user or system that created the refund request.

createdAt.description: The timestamp when the refund request was created.

automated.description: Indicates whether the refund request was made automatically.

AuditDetails.description: Details about the audit information associated with the refund operation.

x-processing-time.description: Indicates the time taken to process the request, measured in milliseconds. This helps in assessing the performance of the API endpoint.
